basic_info.description: Introducing the one-of-a-kind Grand Penthouse, a luxurious 2,450SF residence perched on the best southwest corner, offering unparalleled views of the Bay, Oracle Park, and the city skyline. This exceptional home features 3 generously sized bedrooms, 3 beautifully renovated baths, a custom-built home office, and a spacious family room, all framed by iconic views. With over $500K in bespoke upgrades, the residence boasts wide-plank European Oak hardwood floors, designer lighting, New Zealand handmade wool carpets, 5 high-efficiency VRF heating/cooling zones and state-of-the-art smart home features, including Lutron lighting control and Somfy motorized shades. The chef's kitchen showcases high-end SS appliances, Caesarstone countertops, and a Waterchef U9000 filtration system. The master suite offers a private entrance, a lavish custom walk-in closet, and fully remodeled bathrooms with Kohler sinks, designer faucets, and a Graff waterfall shower. Additional highlights include custom shelving, designer paint, and side-by-side two parking with direct elevator access. Situated in a prestigious 24/7 doorman building with top-tier amenities and earthquake insurance, this penthouse is steps from Caltrain, Muni, Central Subway and a short walk to the Ferry Building & Embarcadero Waterfront
